definitions.gloss: to oil; to lubricate; to apply oil
definitions.explanation: To apply oil or lubricant to machinery, hinges, chains, or other mechanical parts to reduce friction and ensure smooth operation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チェーン→チェーン：08833_cheen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{注油|ちゅうゆ}する。
⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{蝶番|ちょうつがい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧きしむ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{注油|ちゅうゆ}した。
examples.english: The door hinges were squeaking, so I oiled them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{寿命|じゅみょう}→寿命：12359_jumyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{延|の}ばす→延ばす：28291_nobasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{定期的|ていきてき}→定期的：06173_teikiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{注油|ちゅうゆ}すること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: To extend the life of machinery, it's important to lubricate it regularly.

notes:
A practical term for the act of applying oil or lubricant to mechanical parts. Common in maintenance manuals, bicycle care, and industrial contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{注油|ちゅうゆ}→注油：18571_chuuyu⟧{口|ぐち}: oil fill port; lubrication point
- ⟦{定期的|ていきてき}→定期的：06173_teikiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{注油|ちゅうゆ}する: to oil regularly
- ⟦{注油|ちゅうゆ}→注油：18571_chuuyu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧: needs oiling

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{潤滑|じゅんかつ}→潤滑：23861_junkatsu⟧: lubrication — more technical term
- ⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}す→差す：17637_sasu⟧: to oil; to grease — everyday expression with the same meaning
- ⟦{給油|きゅうゆ}→給油：18553_kyuuyu⟧: refueling — adding fuel (gasoline), not lubricating oil

FORMS:
⟦{注|ちゅう}→注：03434_chuu⟧ (pour) + {油|ゆ} (oil). Literally 'pour oil.'
